counter.$description: Small numeric pill sitting on top of an already-colored button fill (the icon-left+text+counter-right content variant of both button.primary and button.secondary). A general-purpose standalone counter/badge (for nav items, list rows, etc. on a plain page surface) is deferred until a real use case for it shows up — not built speculatively.

size.$description: Shared by every surface variant below — sizing doesn't depend on which button it sits on, only sm/base/lg does. Not a text-style.* alias — every existing bold text-style (label-sm/base) bakes in uppercase + wide tracking for all-caps words, wrong for digits. Composed directly from typography primitives instead. leading.none (1) rather than normal/tight — a single-line numeric pill centers better with no extra line-box air.

onPrimary.$description: For use on top of an active-colored (fill.active) button/tab. Text is always forActiveBg (dark on the bright active). inactive = a faint lighten-2 (12% white) wash; active = a solid white pill that pops off the active fill.

inactive.$description: Seen/zero count — a faint lighten-2 (white 12%) wash over the active fill, dark text.

active.$description: Has a meaningful count — a solid white pill with dark text so it pops off the active fill.

onNeutral.$description: For use on top of a neutral (secondary button / tab track) surface. inactive = a faint lighten-2 wash with secondary-grey text; active = the active colour (fill.active) so the count pops against the neutral surface, with dark (forActiveBg) text.

active.$description: The active colour (fill.active) pill + dark text — pops against the neutral surface.
